units.source_text: 一看帐单，才晓得一切均按时间计算：早晨五点以前走的，算到五点；第二天十二点以前走的，就算到十二点。

en.t: Looking at the bill, he realized that everything was charged by the time: if one left before five in the morning, it was counted until five; if one left before noon the next day, it was counted until noon.

units.source_text: 驹子在大衣外面围上一条白围巾，把岛村一直送到车站。

en.t: Komako wrapped a white scarf over her coat and escorted Shimamura all the way to the station.

units.source_text: 岛村为了打发时间，去买了些木天蓼酱菜和香蘑罐头一类土特产，

en.t: To pass the time, Shimamura went and bought local specialties such as pickled silver vine and canned nameko mushrooms,

units.source_text: 还富余二十分钟，便走到站前稍高的广场上散步，

en.t: and with twenty minutes still to spare, he walked up to the slightly elevated square in front of the station for a stroll,

units.source_text: 一边眺望着周围的景色，一边想道：“这是布满雪山的狭窄地带啊！”

en.t: gazing at the scenery around him and thinking, "What a narrow stretch of land filled with snowy mountains!"
